Build is clean. The curation is complete and verified:

- **Coverage cross-check**: the spec has 20 operations; the 10 curated tools wrap 16 of them (several tools multiplex two endpoints, e.g. global vs per-network trending). The 4 dropped endpoints (`/tokens/{address}/info`, `/pools/{pool_address}/info`, `/tokens/multi/{addresses}`, `/tokens/info_recently_updated`) are metadata/social-profile surfaces outside the pool-analytics user story.
- **Spec-layer trimming already done**: response structs carry no `image_url`/`banner_image_url`/UI noise — the typed client is the slim shape, and every tool body is `ok(response)`.
- **PREAMBLE reconciled**: all 10 shipped tools have capability lines; fixed one factual drift (rate limit stated as ~30 calls/min, spec says ~10).
- **test.json seed preserved**: existing user_story exercises trending → pool deep-dive → whale trades, the highest-value composite path.
- Only edit needed this pass was the PREAMBLE rate-limit line; `cargo build -p geckoterminal` passes.
